title: New Yorker Finalists
content: A lot of great entries arrived in the “New Yorker Unfinished Cover” contest. There wasn't room to show them all. It was very difficult to choose, but I’ve picked three finalists, and I’d like to ask you to vote for your favorite in the poll at left.(Poll now closed)Kalliopi Monoyios(266 votes--Congratulations, you're the winner)Larry Roibal“The Debt Ceiling”(59 Votes)Matt Soar(70 Votes)The winner will receive a signed and specially remarqued poster forColor and Light: A Guide for the Realist Painter.The New Yorker has promised to do a post on their official blog about this impromptu contest, and I’ll let you know when they do. There is a nice post on theStretchbook blog.
